propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate designed and maintained the automated regression suite covering claim intake, reserve changes and payment authorisation, running nightly in the pipeline.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the coverage map document the suite.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reproduced and triaged defects from regression runs and acceptance sessions, recording root causes in the defect tracker.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the triage work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned release quality end-to-end and held the production quality sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns final scope, exit criteria and the sign-off to the QA lead; the referee's remark that the sign-off was 'a formality' describes influence, not the authority held.

expectedGap: The materials show suite design, triage and scope proposals; they do not show the candidate holding the quality sign-off or setting exit criteria.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: scope proposed by the candidate, final scope, exit criteria and sign-off by the QA lead.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ever gave the production quality sign-off himself or set exit criteria, and for which releases.
